offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Prototype Development: $50 for 1 Billion tokens ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: $500 for 11 Billion tokens ($0.045 / 1M tokens)
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 用量计费；每次搜索固定消耗 token，起始为 10000 tokens
offerings.free_quota: Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Free; Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: 返回排名前五的搜索结果及其 URL 和正文，每项为干净的 LLM-friendly text；JSON 模式返回五项列表
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 调用；免费/付费密钥100 RPM，高级密钥1000 RPM。
